Sample.evidence_source: Twelve male farmers (including 1 farm manager) (Mage = 60.17, SD = 7.17), who died by suicide, were each represented by an informant, a close next-of kin (NOK) who had lived with or known the deceased well.

Country.evidence_source: Queensland (QLD) farmer suicide cases were identified utilizing the Queensland Suicide Register (QSR), a suicide mortality database managed by the Australian Institute for Suicide Research and Prevention (AISRAP).
